resources.string: Mapbox AI Voice Navigation Sample App
Add your Mapbox public access token in Settings to load the map.
Create a public token at mapbox.com and paste it here. Tokens are not included in cloud or device backups. The map loads after you save a token.
Bring your own OpenAI API key. It is stored on this device, is not included in cloud or device backups, and is used only to connect voice sessions to OpenAI.
Open the map settings menu to switch between simulated location and live GPS.
This sample uses your OpenAI account for voice. Do not use it while driving unless it is safe and legal where you are. You are responsible for your OpenAI usage and costs.
Map display and routing use your Mapbox access token and Mapbox services, subject to Mapbox terms.
The app needs microphone and location access for voice commands and navigation. Permission prompts appear when you first start a session.
Add your OpenAI API key in Settings before starting.
